# Payments

Overview of [payouts](settlement.md) and the [ledger](../notes/ledger.md).

## Instant payouts

Instant payouts settle in minutes. See the [cutoffs](cutoffs.md#cutoff-times) page.

### Windows

A window is a [ten minute](../notes/ledger.md#accounts) interval.

## Settlement

Settlement runs daily; [[cutoffs]] has the times.
